PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
